content:
maria: FYI customer 'Parcelly' opened an escalation — after today's rollout their responses are now prefacing answers with 'Note:' and inventing delivery dates (e.g., 'Arrives by June 2') even when source data has no shipping info. Also some SKUs are getting truncated mid-token. They attached examples.
sophie: ugh. Do we have the request IDs / model name / rollout id from the customer? Need the raw request/response pairs and the prompt logs to triage.
maria: Customer pasted one sample (redacted):
```
request_id: r_0a9f1c2d
model: open-redwood-3b-v2
prompt: "What is the shipping ETA for SKU: ZX-1199-AL?"
response_before (yesterday): "Estimated shipping: Not listed. Check seller page."
response_after (today): "Note: Items typically arrive within 3-5 business days. Arrives by June 2."
```
sophie: can you confirm they pinned a model version or used 'auto' routing? If they used a model alias that got mapped to a new variant during rollout that's suspicious.
maria: They said they did NOT pin; using default model alias. Rollout window started ~ 1799996000 according to their timezone note.
oliver: pls ask customer for the minimal repro (single short prompt + exact output). Also need the full request payload: temperature, top_p, max_tokens, stop sequences, streaming vs non-streaming, and any prompt pre/post-processing.
maria: Sent them a checklist:
- full request JSON (remove PII)
- request_ids for failing calls (we got r_0a9f1c2d and r_0b4d22ef so far)
- model name/alias and timestamp
- whether they used dedicated/dedicated-fallback/hosted
- example of expected output vs actual
- short minimal prompt to reproduce
james: I'm looping in infra. @oliver can you check if kernel selection/quantization profile changed in that rollout? Also check if KV cache handling change could cause token chopping mid-sku.
oliver: on it. quick internal checks: deploy-bot shows a canary -> prod rollout for open-redwood-3b-v2 at 1799995400. We should check runtime flags: attention-optimizations=enabled, kv-cache-truncation=fixed-size (new), tokenizer-version=2026-02-18.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment open-redwood-3b-v2 rolled to 20% at 1799995400, 100% at 1799999200 :rocket:
sophie: if tokenizer version changed that's a strong lead for sku tokenization/truncation. Also the 'Note:' preface and confident date generation points to a prompt-conditioning/regression — maybe a default system prompt got updated during rollout.
maria: customer replied with another failing request id r_0b4d22ef and included partial logs. They said it started exactly after 1799999200. Asking them for the minimal repro now.
james: if they can provide a single-line minimal prompt that reproduces we can pin them back to previous model variant as a mitigation. Can we temporarily map their alias to previous build? Sophie/infra: what's the rollback / pin procedure for customer alias? Need ops playbook.
oliver: mitigation plan:
1) Ask customer for minimal repro + full request JSON (temp, top_p, model alias, request_id)
2) If repro confirmed, pin their alias to open-redwood-3b-v1 (pre-rollout) and notify them
3) Eng-runtime will collect logs for tokenizer + kernel selection around those request_ids
sophie: I'll draft the reply to customer asking for the minimal repro and giving them how-to get prompt logs from their SDK (include example code snippet). Keep it simple.
maria: Draft to customer (sent): "Thanks — could you paste a single minimal prompt (one line) that triggers the bad output, include the request_id and full request JSON (redact PII). Also tell us model alias and exact timestamp of the call. We'll try pinning your alias while we investigate. If you can't paste full JSON, attach a screenshot of your request log."
oliver: also ask them to include a short 'expected output' vs 'actual output' pair. This speeds evals.
james: tagging eng-sre to watch for spikes in similar reports. If multiple customers report tokenizer regression we'll rollback globally.
deploy-bot: Note: automatic rollback not configured for tokenizer regressions. Manual pin required.
sophie: customer replied: "Sending r_0b4d22ef and minimal prompt now" :eyes:
maria: great — once they post the minimal repro we'll try to reproduce in staging with tokenizers set to old vs new version and report back. I'll update this thread with their sample outputs.
james: thanks team. if we confirm repro, assign a priority P1 and we'll escalate to eng-runtime for a hotfix. :thumbsup:
